tripAdvisorReviews.name: hub by Premier Inn London Spitalfields, Brick Lane hotel
tripAdvisorReviews.address: 86 Brick Lane Spitalfields, London E1 6RL England

reviews.title: Hotel has deteriorated
reviews.text:
This hotel has really gone downhill in my opinion.  I have stayed here a few times as the location is great and it is usually value for money. 

This trip there were hardly any mugs for tea and coffee - there are no kettles in the room, you collect your tea or coffee from a station on the ground floor.

I was on a four night trip and after the first night I let the manager know that the TV in my room appeared to only have about 5 channels on it, BBC1 and BBC2, no ITV, Channel 4 or 5 and not many of the other channels. They reset the TV in my room but this did not fix it and said it was a central problem affecting all the TVs. However this was not reset and the channels were not restored during my stay. I was out and about a lot and it would have been good to be able to relax in my room watching TV some of the time. The screen mirroring in my room did not work either so watching TV via my iPad was not an option. 

The final straw for me was Sunday morning when I wanted to go down to the ground floor to get a cup of tea and the lifts were both in use by hotel staff moving huge boxes of clean and dirty linen around the floors. Finally a lift arrived (4th attempt) which had the boxes but no staff so I wheeled the box onto the floor and left it there. It would be a better idea, rather than allowing the cleaning staff to hold both lifts on various floors if they used just one of the two lifts available and left the other for guests. I found out there was no service lift but inconveniencing guests in this way is not acceptable. 

Other than that the air con worked, the shower was clean but the bathroom was showing signs of wear and tear. My room was quiet so I got a reasonable nights sleep.

reviews.title: Perfect for single travellers
reviews.text: Perfect for a solo female guest. Location is great, I felt totally safe, staff were friendly and helpful. Love the hub rooms, perfect for 1 and cosy. Spotlessly clean. Only gripe is the air con was loud and I made the room very cold. I couldn’t turn it off, but I was just there one night for a bed so didn’t raise it. Next time I’ll bring something warm to sleep in just in case. I’ve already booked again

I can definitely recommend this place! The staff was really friendly and helped us a lot. They offered additional towels and blankets, and also were available almost all the time for any of our requests and needs . They gave us tips for our trip and also told us all about the different spots in London we shouldn‘t miss. They also warned is about when we shouldn‘t go to different areas in London, because of the safety there. Especially Mister Rahim, he talked with us a lot and made us feel very welcome while our short stay there. He also showed us the mosque and some different food spots. 

Definitely can recommend this place and will go there the next time too!

reviews.title: OK but would probably stay elsewhere next time in London.
reviews.text: The staff were great.  The bed was comfortable and the location on Brick Lane was perfect.  No noise at night.  However I wouldn't stay here again as I would like to be able to make drinks in the room.  The shower was not a power shower as described and was very weak.  Lighting was odd and there was no in between working.  Breakfast on the Saturday was good, but Sunday they couldn't keep up with demand and were running around trying react to what people couldn't find.

reviews.title: Great value pleasantly surprised
reviews.text: This is actually a great hotel, location is spot on, our room (in the basement) still had a small window and we heard no noise at all. The room is compact but cleverly designed. It was clean and ideal for us and the staff for lovely. Would stay here again!
